summary: The checked-out source unconditionally routed OffloaderV2 expert-count vectors through copy_to_gpu_no_ce, whose native dispatch rejected the reported 16-element vector and every size except 32, 64, and 72. The correction adds an N=16 specialization plus a bounded by-value fallback through N=512, preserving the no-copy-engine requirement. The modified native source was compiled and exact-copy tested on the assigned gfx950 GPU.

tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed the prepared ROCm wheel does not register copy_to_gpu_no_ce; raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-3ab50de5160a/evidence/before-reproduction.log. Source inspection independently confirmed the checked-out native dispatch only accepts N=32, 64, and 72 and therefore rejects the reported N=16.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-3ab50de5160a/torch_extensions MAX_JOBS=8 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-3ab50de5160a/venv/bin/python <focused torch extension build and GPU test>
tests.what_was_measured: Compiled the modified copy.cu with pinned ROCm 7.2.4 for gfx950 and executed exact int32 CPU-to-GPU copies for N=16, 17, 32, 64, 72, and 512; independently compared GPU results with the CPU inputs at rtol=0 and atol=0. Also verified N=0 and N=513 rejection. Raw compiler and runtime output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-3ab50de5160a/evidence/native-build-and-gpu-test.log.

gpu_execution_evidence: The focused native extension ran on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack- and produced exact expected int32 vectors for all six accepted test sizes.
native_rebuild_evidence: The changed copy.cu was HIP-translated with zero unsupported CUDA calls, compiled by /opt/rocm-7.2.4/bin/hipcc including --offload-arch=gfx950, linked into copy_no_ce.so, loaded, and exercised instead of using the preinstalled wheel.
remaining_limitations: The original GLM-5.2 weights were unavailable.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so the reported two-node TP16/EP16 DeepEP serving configuration was not reproduced.
The report originated on NVIDIA H800/CUDA, while native execution here used ROCm 7.2.4 on gfx950; CUDA compilation and H800 execution remain unverified locally.
The prepared ROCm sglang-kernel wheel omits the copy_to_gpu_no_ce operator, so failing-before runtime evidence is source-dispatch evidence rather than an invocation of the packaged operator.
clang-format was unavailable in the prepared environment.
